brief: Triage of Octave's issues #289 (ship Octave's web client; narrow D-027) and #288 (episodes lack SeriesName), with D-085's owner direction, and the findings JS-160 and JS-127 left unfixed.

entry: D-085's direction is followed and nothing is built yet. A narrowed lift of D-027 covers only serving the web build (deep links, cache headers, precompressed assets), its pages' response headers including a CSP, and the e2e tier against it. It takes effect when the owner approves PRODUCT.md's wording and says what 'default' means, Octave's project publishes a pinned build with its browser playback measurement, and the lead measures the worker cost of repackaging on the dogfood. Until then D-027 stands whole. JS-150 and D-033 are unchanged and /web/ stays jellyfin-web's. BL-229 keeps D-083's trigger. #288 becomes a JS-047 criterion. BL-277 is backlog (promote at JS-056's fresh-cluster run or an operator's report), BL-278 is dropped, J127-a is BL-283, J127-b is a JS-151 criterion.
serves: PRODUCT.md: 'Octave first'; goal 3; 'Their library feels alive'. Owner, 2026-11-22: nothing outruns the product.
